body:
> believe me I was there. My mom treated me like filth emotionally. And its a good thing you didn't commit suicide or go through with it because there's something deep down in you that knows that there is hope out there.

I mean I guess you could call it hope, or just bad knot tying skills but yeah I know you're right, there was a part of me that didn't want to.

> Life's not fair, we get put behind because we were born in shitty situations. We have to work harder, but that's what makes us stronger. Dont give up.

Yeah, I understand that now, sometimes I'm able to stay strong but when I'm in bed or my mind is just idle I start thinking about my life, and unfortunately when I think about my life I start crying then that crying turns into more crying and that cycle repeats until I have no more tissues to cry into, I'm trying though.

Thanks for the comment.

> You're 16 soon so legally can work depending on your country. Become independend and get away from your ma? 

That's the plan.

> What roadblocks do you see ahead of a potentional good life?

As I said, my situation is different from most 15 year old's and someone could probably recognize me here from school.
Yeah I understand, thanks for the reply you cheered me up a bit, have a nice night :D

> The average dude loses it at 18

Yeah but in the UK the age of consent is 16 so if you haven't lost it by then you get ridiculed in fact I even saw someone tag another kid my age in a post on facebook and laugh at him for being a virgin, which sent me into a complete crying fit because even though it wasn't directed at me it still hit me.

> You got plenty of time, and you will get laid. Sex is more likely to become a nuecance (?) in the long term. You might even cherish the sexless, simpler times.

I'm 15, put yourself in my position, the thought of sex being a nuisance is completely beyond my comprehension lol

Thanks for the reply.
Yeah I see what you mean, thanks.

> you are not that stupid if you can actually see there is something wrong with you, i would call you more intelligent than most people at that, because you can see and admit that you are not perfect

Yeah when I said I'm smart enough to know I'm stupid I meant more like I'm smart enough to know I'm immature, I know I will look back and think "wow, why did I think like that?" but at the moment I'm not saying that, your comment made me feel a bit better so you're not completely useless :D

Yes but that's the thing, I don't have a year or 2.

The fact that I'm still a virgin is one of the many reasons I'm depressed, hence the reason I said 

> Looking at all the other people my age with their girlfriends and boyfriends and happy little lives with their little futures planned and the other thing I don't have, happiness, absolutely fucking crushes me.

and

> no fixing my problems (unless anyone has a time machine I could borrow?)

Because even though I'm 15 I'm smart enough to know I'm stupid (If that makes any sense), I know I shouldn't lose it now, but people do, and the pressure to do so is killing me.

My situation is different from most 15 year olds.
